integrity: Computations use exact integer enumeration independently checked against the defining axioms; the argument that enumeration is exhaustive is a mathematical principal-filter lemma, not an assumption from finite sampling. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-operation and isomorphism counts are for Boolean powersets of at most three atoms; only the selector normal form holds for arbitrary finite atom sets. The comparison with prior work does not establish absolute historical uniqueness.
title: Eight-element Boolean preconditionals: exact census and first unavoidable multivalued selection
